This video isn't just about a lack of evidence. It's about a profound structural contradiction. Christianity has survived for two millennia by mastering a brilliant rhetorical loop. It tells you the world has already been saved while treating the entire human race like it's still drowning. So we return to the central question. If Jesus saved the world, why is it still not saved? Maybe the answer is that nothing actually changed. Maybe the story tells us that a conqueror arrived to rewrite the cosmos, but history shows us the status quo never blinked. At some point, the poetry of the sermon has to face the reality of the human condition, because at the end of the day, you cannot honestly claim the work is finished when every single enemy is still on the clock.
